heading: INT. CAR DECK - NIGHT FERRY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CAR DECK - NIGHT FERRY - NIGHT
Rows of parked cars chained to the steel floor.
Diesel fumes and cold salt.
Overhead lamps sway with the swell.
SORAYA KAMALI (30s, plainclothes agent, wet hair, a pistol held low against her thigh) crouches behind a delivery van.
She whispers into her sleeve.
Across the aisle, LEV ARKADYEV (50s, silver mustache, cashmere coat) sits calmly on a bumper with a leather case on his knees.
He is not hiding.
You can come out, Agent Kamali. I bought your ticket myself.
units.name: LEV

units.text: She does not move.
Behind Lev, MARGUERITE DELACROIX (40s, ship's purser, uniform too crisp) appears at the stairwell door, a keyring in one hand, and stops when she sees the gun.
At the far end of the deck, DUTCH PELLEGRINO (60s, deckhand, oil-stained overalls, a wrench) steps out from behind a truck, takes in the three of them, and starts to back away.
Soraya stands, aims at Lev, and swings her head toward the noise.
Marguerite raises both hands, the keyring jingling.
Lev opens the case on his knees and takes out nothing but a thermos.
Tea?
units.name: LEV

units.text: Put it down.
units.name: SORAYA

units.text: It's tea.
units.name: LEV

units.text: Miss, I'm only the purser. I was told to bring him the key to the cabin.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Whose cabin?
units.name: SORAYA

units.text: Yours.
units.name: MARGUERITE

units.text: Soraya hesitates.
Dutch, still backing, bumps a car alarm that begins to whoop.
Everyone flinches.
Lev does not.
He pours tea into the thermos lid, and steam rises in the cold.
The man you came here to arrest got off at the last port. I wanted to see your face when you understood.
units.name: LEV

units.text: Then why are you still aboard?
units.name: SORAYA

units.text: Because you are the one I wanted.
units.name: LEV

units.text: Dutch silences the alarm with a wrench, and the deck goes quiet but for the engines.
Marguerite lowers her hands.
Soraya lowers the gun an inch, then another.
Dutch stays by the truck, wrench loose in his fist, looking at nobody.
Ma'am, I think the captain knows.
units.name: DUTCH

units.text: Knows what?
units.name: SORAYA

units.text: That none of us is going to the next port.
units.name: DUTCH

units.text: Lev sips his tea.
Marguerite looks at her keyring as if she has never seen it before.
Soraya raises her gun again, but slower this time, like a woman reading a verdict.
Everyone stay exactly where you are.
units.name: SORAYA

units.text: We have nowhere else to be.
units.name: LEV
